articles.title: Gaganyaan delays should be taken with 'pinch of salt': Astronaut Angad Pratap

He stressed that such challenges are crucial for meticulous planning and execution, especially for India's ambitious Gaganyaan mission. This highlights the rigorous process ensuring utmost safety and success for the nation's indigenous human spaceflight endeavour.

articles.title: nspect added to PyPI
articles.summary: A new Rust-based Command Line Interface (CLI) tool has been developed to deeply analyze C# projects and solutions. It provides crucial insights into dependency graphs, package references, and potential version conflicts. Furthermore, it calculates vital structural metrics such as Lines of Code and cyclomatic complexity, helping C# developers manage and understand complex software projects more effectively.
